sourceSemantics.historicalMissing: V111 MISSING is a conservative family-matcher absence in its Homeworld inventory, not proof every matching noun has no file anywhere in the repository.
sourceSemantics.currentScope: All17 exact IDs/labels/lore compared to V81 catalogue and V112 artTargets. commonAdmissionCriteria.requirement: Original independent native PNG/atlas cell, silhouette whole, positive uniform scale, explicit native rectangle/dimensions/pivot, actual alpha and occupied bounds including all margins and edge pixels; do not manufacture missing function by extracting a painted detail. Preserve original bytes and SHA256/provenance.

Keep exact target ID, role/function, provenance category and candidate status. Existing presence, decode, tests or an assistant inspection never grant human artistic validated status. This audit closes no catalogue entry.

Prop isolation screenshot with a real reference Yautja; inspect silhouette, scale, pivot, alpha, orientation and physical ground support. World dimensions are separate from bitmap dimensions and collision footprint.

Inspect in actual district with wide/medium/near screenshots; verify free approach, usage and exit space, depth and ground support. Common props need visual diversity ideally4–8 native variants. A candidate image does not prove integration/gameplay completion.

Verify plot support, facade orientation, reachable entrance, true passage/cabin clearance and both travel directions. Existing lift V82 must be reviewed rather than regenerated merely because of historical MISSING. No route or collision claim arises from an image.
Author left/right views independently where requested; do not rotate, mirror, skew or stretch a PNG to claim a missing native orientation.

deliveryProposal.format: Raw native transparent PNG, independent full object or explicitly authored atlas cells; preserve exact generated bytes and receipt/prompt/SHA256.
deliveryProposal.dimensions: Architectural families may use landscape framing; props may use square framing. Requested dimensions are not guaranteed by image_gen; record actual dimensions without resampling. Source imposes no target pixel dimensions.
deliveryProposal.frame: Whole raw PNG or native frame rectangle declared explicitly; complete silhouette and transparent safety margin including minor protrusions, shadow, fittings and top.
deliveryProposal.pivot: Measure physical support/attachment on actual pixels. Floor props: support point; wall parts: fastening/interface; holes/doors: threshold. Do not assume all pivots are bottom-center.
deliveryProposal.orientation: Native oblique view coherent with each reference family, no CSS mirror/rotation/skew/stretch to claim an authored missing view.
deliveryProposal.qualification: Isolation with a reference Yautja, then actual district/context at wide/medium/near distances; inspect scale, alpha, occupied borders, complete silhouette, support, orientation, depth, access and usage. Scene behavior/animation are separate proofs.
